decision.rationale: No new inject at T+75. I continue to seek telecom network incident information from the licensed telecom operator under the illustrative regulator information-request rule, as no telecom incident report has been received and no telecom-specific obligation has been triggered.
uncertainty: Whether a significant network incident affecting a public telecommunications service has occurred.
Whether the telecom operator is aware of any such incident and within what timeframe it would be required to report.
